scope: Original composer Sketch editor with synthetic pointer input; renderer unchanged

Undo removed visible stroke, disabled Undo/Attach and enabled Redo

v53 original Shapes menu lists Line, Arrow, Rectangle, Ellipse, Triangle, Diamond, Star and Heart; only Rectangle exercised in this pass
